# Eligibility Requirements Checklist: Eligibility Filtering

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of the eligibility-filtering requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are route-candidate identity and uniqueness rules defined for every supported routing surface? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 Are protected and non-protected request semantics, including who or what declares them, fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, FR-003, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all eligibility states, confidence-score bounds, and confidence interpretation rules defined? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, §Key Entities, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements for an empty candidate set and a candidate set with no eligible members explicit? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §Edge Cases, FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the specification identify every supported public route surface whose eligibility behavior must remain consistent? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the required contents, intended audience, and sensitivity limits of a routing explanation fully described? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2, FR-005, §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are “eligible,” “ineligible,” “low confidence,” and “best-available information” defined without overlapping or contradictory meanings? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-003, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “immediately before final selection” bounded well enough to distinguish an authoritative check from a stale earlier evaluation? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the confidence-score scale and the threshold that triggers protected fail-closed behavior stated explicitly? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the per-request-type permission for best-available admission clearly owned, defaulted, and constrained? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the User Story 1 acceptance scenarios, edge cases, FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, and FR-006 describe one consistent admission sequence? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, FR-001–FR-003, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the FR-007 best-available exception remain consistent with the protected fail-closed requirement in FR-003? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, FR-003, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the success criteria measure the same candidate membership and exclusion concepts used by the functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements, §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the assumptions about existing candidate sources and routing review surfaces consistent with the stated feature scope? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, FR-004, FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001 be evaluated objectively across every protected request path, including missing, stale, and failed eligibility information? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-002 be evaluated objectively for both complete candidate pools and single-candidate explanations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, FR-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-003 define the complete comparison set and the meaning of a repeat check across public route surfaces? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the “under 30 seconds” review target in SC-004 tied to a defined reviewer context and identifiable explanation contents? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, FR-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are missing, unavailable, malformed, unauthorized, denied, quota, rate-limit, and policy-denied states distinguished where their outcomes differ? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are state transitions between initial evaluation and final selection specified for both exclusion and survival outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, §Edge Cases, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behavior of requesting an explanation after the original decision, including any unavailable historical context, specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Are failure and recovery expectations defined when the eligibility information source or its freshness data is unavailable? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, FR-003]

## Non-Functional and Dependency Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Is the permitted latency impact of authoritative re-checking quantified or explicitly bounded? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK024 Are freshness, staleness, and cache-authority expectations defined for the eligibility information source? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, FR-003, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK025 Are privacy and security requirements for candidate identifiers, exclusion reasons, and explanation output explicit? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, FR-005]
- [ ] CHK026 Are retention, replay, and audit expectations for routing explanations and eligibility decisions documented or intentionally excluded? [Gap, Spec §User Story 2, FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- This checklist evaluates requirements writing, not implementation behavior or test execution.
